question: If sin x – 3 cos x = sqrt3 cos x, then find the value of cot x.
solution:
Given:

sin x - 3 cos x = √3 cos x

To Find:

The value of cot x.

Calculation:

Rearrange the equation:

sin x = (√3 + 3) cos x

Divide both sides by cos x:

sin x / cos x = √3 + 3

tan x = √3 + 3

cot x = 1 / tan x = 1 / (√3 + 3)

Rationalize the denominator:

cot x = (1 / (√3 + 3)) × ((√3 - 3) / (√3 - 3))

cot x = (√3 - 3) / ((√3 + 3)(√3 - 3))

cot x = (√3 - 3) / (3 - 9)

cot x = (√3 - 3) / -6

cot x = (3 - √3) / 6

∴ The value of cot x is (3 - √3) / 6 (Option 3).
